newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Bilbao rules out raising Provincial stake.
newsitem.headline: Bilbao rules out raising Provincial stake.

text.p: Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya is not interested in raising its recently-acquired 40 percent in leading Venezuelan bank Banco Provincial, a local Bilbao representative said Friday.

"We're very satisfied with the 40 percent. We don't have any special interest in doing it (raising the stake)," Javier Sanchez, Banco Bilbao Vizcaya's local representative told reporters after a banking forum in Caracas.

Bilbao's purchase of the Provincial stake was due to be concluded March 20, the same day as a shareholders meeting. Bilbao bought its stake from French bank Credit Lyonnais, which owned 17 percent and local brewers Empresas Polar. The operation was reported to have cost more than $300 million.
Sanchez said Bilbao was still interested in expanding its operations in Latin America. The only countries in the region where it is not represented are Brazil, Ecuador and Chile, he said.
